children: Caleres (NYSE: CAL), a market-leading portfolio of consumer-driven footwear brands, today announced that it will report its second quarter 2026 financial results one day earlier than previously scheduled. The company will release its results before market open on

, followed by a conference call at 10 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss the results and provide a general business update. The reporting of results and conference call were previously scheduled for September 10.

Investors, Caleres associates, media, and the public are invited to join the call. Participants in North America can dial (877) 704-4453, while international callers may use (201) 389-0920; no passcode is required. Caleres is a market-leading portfolio of global footwear brands that includes Famous Footwear, Sam Edelman, Stuart Weitzman, Allen Edmonds, Naturalizer, Vionic, and more. Our products are available virtually everywhere - in the ~1,000 retail stores we operate, in hundreds of major department and specialty stores, on our branded e-commerce sites, and on many additional third-party retail platforms. Combined, these brands make Caleres a company with both a legacy and a mission.
